Title: BBC televises hastily assembled Freddie Mercury tribute

Title: Queen publicly disavow apartheid and rule out a Sun City return
Summary: After Sun City's entertainment director suggests a Queen return 'should not be ruled out' amid the Artists United Against Apartheid controversy, Queen issue a statement saying they have no plans to return to Sun City and have 'a total abhorrence of apartheid'.

Title: Pope John Paul II's UK visit forces Queen to relocate two 1982 stadium shows
Summary: Planned Queen concerts at Manchester's Old Trafford and London's Arsenal are cancelled after all portable chemical toilets in the UK are booked up for cities being visited by Pope John Paul II; the shows move to Leeds United's Elland Road and the Milton Keynes Bowl.

Title: David Bowie recites the Lord's Prayer and reunites with Mott the Hoople and the Spiders From Mars at the Tribute Concert
Summary: At the Freddie Mercury Tribute Concert, David Bowie closes his segment by reciting the Lord's Prayer on one knee to underline the show's AIDS-awareness message, then leads a one-off reunion of Spiders From Mars and Mott the Hoople musicians - Mick Ronson on guitar and Ian Hunter on vocals - through 'All The Young Dudes', backed by Brian May, Roger Taylor and John Deacon.
